stratified_examples.question: How can I redeem my 250 free business cards with the Wix Logo Maker plan?
stratified_examples.candidate_answer:
To redeem your 250 free business cards with the Wix Logo Maker plan, follow these steps:

- Purchase an Unlimited or Business Wix Logo Maker plan to be eligible.
- Go to the Brand Studio in your Wix account.
- Click the "My Brands" drop-down at the top and select your relevant brand.
- Click "Brand Actions" and select "Print Logo on Merchandise."
- Click "Get Started" next to Business Cards.
- Choose a template by hovering over it and clicking "Select."
- Add your business details, then click "Save & Continue."
- Click "Add to Cart" — the business cards should be free (price 0) in the cart.
- Complete the checkout to have the double-sided cards shipped to your door.

Note: The free cards must be redeemed using the logo included in your purchased plan and cannot be transferred to another account or redeemed by collaborators [S1][S2].

stratified_examples.question: How can I redeem my 250 free business cards with the Wix Logo Maker plan?
stratified_examples.candidate_answer:
To redeem your 250 free business cards with the Wix Logo Maker plan, follow these steps:

- Purchase an Unlimited or Business Wix Logo Maker plan to be eligible.
- Go to the Brand Studio in your Wix account.
- Click the "My Brands" drop-down at the top and select your relevant brand.
- Click "Brand Actions" and select "Print Logo on Merchandise."
- Click "Get Started" next to Business Cards.
- Choose a template by hovering over it and clicking "Select."
- Add your business details, then click "Save & Continue."
- Click "Add to Cart" — the business cards should be free (price 0) in the cart.
- Complete the checkout to have the double-sided cards shipped to your door.

Note: The free cards must be redeemed using the logo included in your purchased plan and cannot be transferred to another account or redeemed by collaborators [S1][S2].
stratified_examples.gt_answer:
To redeem your 250 free business cards with the Wix Logo Maker plan, follow these steps:

1. Go to the [Brand Studio](http://www.wix.com/logo/maker/esh).
2. Click the **My Brands** drop-down at the top.
3. Select the relevant brand.
4. Click **Brand Actions** at the top.
5. Select **Print Logo on Merchandise**.
6. Click **Get Started** beside **Business Cards**.
7. Hover over the template you like best and click **Select.**
8. Add your business details and click **Save & Continue.**
9. Click **Add to Cart** (In the cart, the price of the business cards should be 0).
10. Choose whether you want to customize the design.
11. Click **Continue** to place an order.

stratified_examples.question: How can I create a new album in the Shared Gallery app on my live site?
stratified_examples.candidate_answer:
To create a new album in the Shared Gallery app on your live site, follow these steps:

- Go to the Shared Gallery section in your site's dashboard or directly on your live site.
- Log in with the email address associated with your Wix account.
- Click "Create Album."
- Enter a name and description for the album.
- Click the Add icon to upload a cover image.
- Click "Create Album" to finalize.

Note: You and any site visitor with Manage Gallery permissions can create albums. After creating your first album, all photos and videos will be organized into albums, and you can only add media to albums, not individually to the main gallery page [S1][S2].
stratified_examples.gt_answer:
To create a new album on your live site using the Shared Gallery app, follow these steps:

1. Go to the Shared Gallery page on your site.
2. Log in with the email address associated with your Wix account.
3. Click **Create Album**.
4. Enter a name and description for your album.
5. Click the Add icon ![](https://d2x3xhvgiqkx42.cloudfront.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-1234567890ab/9dcc39dd-da6f-4c38-b1c3-ee79d33f39d5/2021/11/12/13ed5068-32fa-452e-af44-6a7bfea3b16a/e7e3e187-3586-4b86-aa02-66d1a9592d0e.png) to add a cover image.
6. Click **Create Album**.

### Important
* When you create your first album, another album with the same name as your site is also created. All of the photos and videos that you previously uploaded are automatically moved to this folder.
* Your gallery's main page will also display only albums instead of individual photos and videos.
* To return to displaying individual photos and videos, you need to [delete your albums](https://support.wix.com/en/article/creating-and-managing-albums-in-the-shared-gallery-app#deleting-an-album).
